summary: I changed one file, `solution/core.py`, which had two off-by-one errors, and the visible suite now passes (3 passed). First, `_align` worked out the padding as `width - len(text) - 1`, so every cell came out one space short of its column width and the borders didn't line up. I changed it to `width - len(text)`. Second, the wrap loop in `_cell_lines` used `while len(line) > width - 1`, so a line exactly as long as the column was still split, leaving an empty extra line (the stray `|       |` row under a header). I changed the condition to `len(line) > width`, so only lines longer than the column get wrapped.
